code='''def transform(grid):
    h,w=len(grid),len(grid[0]); out=[r[:] for r in grid]
    seen=set(); objs=[]
    for r in range(h):
        for c in range(w):
            color=grid[r][c]
            if color==0 or (r,c) in seen: continue
            stack=[(r,c)]; seen.add((r,c)); cells=[]
            while stack:
                y,x=stack.pop(); cells.append((y,x))
                for dy,dx in ((1,0),(-1,0),(0,1),(0,-1)):
                    q=(y+dy,x+dx)
                    if 0<=q[0]<h and 0<=q[1]<w and q not in seen and grid[q[0]][q[1]]==color:
                        seen.add(q); stack.append(q)
            ys=[p[0] for p in cells]; xs=[p[1] for p in cells]
            a,b,minx,maxx=min(ys),max(ys),min(xs),max(xs)
            if b-a>=2 and maxx-minx>=2 and all(grid[a][x]==color and grid[b][x]==color for x in range(minx,maxx+1)) and all(grid[y][minx]==color and grid[y][maxx]==color for y in range(a,b+1)):
                inner=[[grid[y][x] for x in range(minx+1,maxx)] for y in range(a+1,b)]
                objs.append((a,b,minx,maxx,color,inner))
    src=max(objs,key=lambda o:sum(v!=0 for row in o[5] for v in row))
    pat=src[5]; ph,pw=len(pat),len(pat[0])
    for a,b,x,z,col,inner in objs:
        if (a,b,x,z,col,inner)==src: continue
        ih,iw=len(inner),len(inner[0])
        if any(v for row in inner for v in row): continue
        for i in range(ih):
            for j in range(iw): out[a+1+i][x+1+j]=col if pat[i%ph][j%pw]!=0 else 0
    return out
'''
